title: Audit: crypto2dev 2026-04-17
notes: Confidence calibration: FIPS gate coverage: 90% — 7 violations found, all in wolfssl (aes_cbc/aes_gcm update, all 5 sess_reset). Residual 10%: did not trace every callback in wolfssl_provider.c for sign/verify/agree key ops — those paths not audited for gate placement. Key material leak risk: 5% — memzero_explicit discipline is strong; main residual risk is partial sess_init failure leaving key in wolfCrypt internal state not visible to framework. UAPI stability: HIGH RISK — SET_AAD/GET_TAG/SET_TAG ioctls not dispatched is a critical regression; all AEAD is broken. Gaps: could not run lockdep to verify no sleeping-in-atomic violations; could not run wolfCrypt FIPS POST failure injection to verify gate behavior under degraded conditions; RSA/EC key ops in wolfssl_provider.c not audited for FIPS gate placement. Would raise confidence if: (1) lockdep run on a test kernel, (2) FIPS POST failure injected during an active session, (3) wolfssl RSA/EC key op callbacks audited for gate placement.
